Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Quarterfoil Wool Runner Rug, 2' 3" x 7' 6", Light Multi
Colors: Light Multicolor
Materials: wool
100% Wool Imported Add transitional flair to your home with this attractive hand tufted pure wool quarterfoil pattered runner. The Moroccan-inspired latice design in light shades of blue, green, grey, and tan will add an elegant flair to your home. 2'3" x 7'6" Hand tufted from pure wool Made in India Medium pile height makes it durable and easy to vacuum Vacuum, professionally clean Pair with a rug pad, which is sold separately Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
